grammar: How do you feel? I feel…because…
intro_zh: 在這一課，我們將學習用英文描述自己的心情和想法，並練習使用「How do you feel? I feel…because…」的句型來說明感覺的原因。透過日常生活的情境，讓學生能夠自然表達喜怒哀樂，並了解不同情緒背後的想法。
can_do: 能用英文說出自己的感覺並說明原因
能聽懂並回應別人對感覺的描述
能閱讀短文並回答關於情緒的問題

sentences.en: This morning Xiao Ming felt excited because he was going to the school science fair.
sentences.zh: 今天早上小明感到興奮，因為他要去參加學校科學展。

sentences.en: When he arrived, he noticed the crowd was loud and he felt a little afraid, but he was also surprised to see his friends, and he felt angry when someone bumped into him.
sentences.zh: 他到達時，注意到人群很吵，他感到有點害怕，但看到朋友也感到驚訝，當有人撞到他時他感到生氣。

sentences.en: During the fair, he felt proud when his project won a prize, and he felt happy about his hard work.
sentences.zh: 在展覽期間，他的項目獲獎時他感到驕傲，並且對自己的努力感到快樂。

sentences.en: After the fair, Xiao Ming felt tired and a bit weak because he had walked all day.
sentences.zh: 展覽結束後，小明感到疲倦且有點虛弱，因為他整天走路。

sentences.en: He felt bored on the bus ride home, and he wished he could do something more fun.
sentences.zh: 回家的公車上他感到無聊，願意做更有趣的事。

sentences.en: When he got home, he noticed his little sister was sick and looked unhappy.
sentences.zh: 回到家時，他注意到妹妹生病了，看起來不高興。

sentences.en: He felt sad and lonely because he could not play with her, but he stayed to keep her company.
sentences.zh: 他感到悲傷且孤單，因為不能和她玩，但他留下來陪她。

sentences.en: Later, his mom gave him a free snack and said he was lucky to have such a caring family.
sentences.zh: 媽媽給他一份免費的點心，並說他很幸運擁有這樣關心的家庭。

sentences.en: Finally, Xiao Ming felt comfortable and glad as he rested, knowing tomorrow would be another great day.
sentences.zh: 最後，小明感到舒適且高興，因為他知道明天又會是美好的一天。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① How do you feel? I feel + 形容詞
grammar_points.explain_zh: 用來詢問對方的感覺，並以形容詞回答。

grammar_points.title_zh: ② 加上原因：I feel … because …
grammar_points.explain_zh: 在感覺後加上 because 來說明產生這種感覺的原因。

examples.en: I feel excited because I have a birthday party today.
examples.zh: 我感到興奮，因為今天有生日派對。

examples.en: I feel sad because I lost my favourite toy.
examples.zh: 我感到難過，因為我遺失了最喜歡的玩具。

examples.en: I feel angry because my brother took my book without asking.
examples.zh: 我感到生氣，因為我的兄弟未經同意拿走了我的書。

examples.en: I feel proud because I got a good grade on the test.
examples.zh: 我感到驕傲，因為我在考試中得到好成績。

lines.en: How do you feel after school?
lines.zh: 安娜，放學後你感覺怎麼樣？

lines.en: I feel tired because we had a long math class.
lines.zh: 本：我感到疲倦，因為我們上了很長的數學課。

lines.en: I feel happy because we played soccer at recess.
lines.zh: 安娜：我感到高興，因為在課間休息時我們踢了足球。

lines.en: I feel a little bored when it rains and we stay inside.
lines.zh: 本：當下雨且我們待在教室時，我會感到有點無聊。
安娜：你現在感覺怎麼樣？

lines.en: I feel great because we just finished our homework.
lines.zh: 本：我感到極好，因為我們剛剛完成功課。

sentences.en: I feel sad because I missed the bus.
sentences.zh: 我感到難過，因為我錯過了公車。

sentences.en: She feels excited because she got a new book.
sentences.zh: 她感到興奮，因為她得到一本新書。

sentences.en: He feels angry because his friend broke his toy.
sentences.zh: 他感到生氣，因為他的朋友弄壞了他的玩具。

sentences.en: We feel lonely when we have no one to play with.
sentences.zh: 我們感到孤單，因為沒有人可以一起玩。

sentences.en: They feel proud because they won the game.
sentences.zh: 他們感到驕傲，因為他們贏得了比賽。

sentences.en: I feel sick because I ate too much candy.
sentences.zh: 我感到不舒服，因為我吃了太多糖果。

sentences.en: You feel free when you ride your bike in the park.
sentences.zh: 你感到自由，當你在公園騎腳踏車時。

mcq.q: 當你很開心時，你會說什麼？
「害怕的」英文怎麼說？
他因為贏得比賽而感到驕傲。他會說什麼？
opts: I feel sad because I won.
I feel proud because I won.
I feel bored because I won.
I feel sick because I won.
mcq.ans: I feel proud because I won.

mcq.q: 「感到孤獨」英文是什麼？
當你生病時，你感到___。
「感到驚訝」的英文動詞片語是什麼？
她因為沒有功課而感到自由。正確的說法是？
opts: She feel free because she has no homework.
She feels free because she has no homework.
She feel happy because she has homework.
She feels sad because she has homework.
mcq.ans: She feels free because she has no homework.

mcq.q: 「虛弱的」英文是___。
你因為無事可做而感到厭倦。你會說什麼？
opts: I feel bored because I have nothing to do.
I feel excited because I have nothing to do.
I feel happy because I have nothing to do.
I feel afraid because I have nothing to do.
mcq.ans: I feel bored because I have nothing to do.

mcq.q: 「注意到」英文怎麼說？
我因為看見老鼠而感到___。
她因為得到禮物而感到___。
他因為沒有朋友而感到___。
你因為考試不及格而感到___。
我因為整天跑步而感到___。
她因為聽到好消息而感到___。
他因為完成作業而感到___。
你因為在公園裡玩耍而感到___。
我因為吃太多糖果而感到___。
她因為得到讚美而感到___。
How do you feel?
